title: Health Center Project Director
statement: Wall framing inspection starts Tuesday—we're checking every stud spacing before drywall goes up. The electricians are pulling wire on the second floor while plumbers test the first-floor risers. Two-shift crews keep us ahead of schedule without cutting corners.
action: On-site at dawn Tuesday to inspect first-wall framing with contractor foreman—verifying 16" on-center spacing and fireblocking before drywall crew arrives.
